title: 西装和裙子

series.next: 老周 needs a third dancer by Saturday. He's asked you.

setting: 金桂苑, an old estate in Hangzhou, 8 pm. The residents' group has a theory.

giveup.en: By morning the rumour has reached the next estate. Run that back. 🍉

wu.name: 吴阿姨
wu.en: 3号楼: knows someone who saw it

zhao.name: 赵奶奶
zhao.en: eighty, sends only sixty-second voice notes

ting.name: 婷婷
ting.en: 老周's daughter, also in the group

laozhou.name: 老周
laozhou.en: 3号楼: retired, lately in a suit every evening

steps.narr: 8 pm. The estate's group chat. The aunties have a theory.

steps.zh: 又看见了！老周穿西装出门了！
steps.en: Saw it again! 老周 went out in a suit!

steps.zh: 方阿姨也穿了裙子，同一个时间！
steps.en: And 方阿姨 in a dress, at the very same time!

steps.zh: 这事儿不简单，我一看就知道。
steps.en: There's more to this. I could tell at a glance.
Pulling up a stool for the show
What do you say, young neighbour?

say.en: Don't join in: tell them not to jump to conclusions.
answers: 大家别乱猜，可能是误会。
say.gloss: Don't say things like that. Maybe they're just busy.
say.tip: 乱 luàn = wildly, carelessly: 别乱说 = don't go saying things. 误会 wùhuì = a misunderstanding.

ok.en: You're young, dear. You don't understand.

fail.en: Has our young neighbour come for the show too?

answers: 眼见为实，没看见就别乱说。
眼见为实，大家别乱说，可能是误会。
4.gloss: Seeing is believing. If you didn't see it, don't say it.
4.tip: 眼见为实 = what you see with your own eyes is real: seeing is believing.

steps.en: ...I'm in this group too, you know.
Don't you worry, 婷婷. Grown-up business.

say.en: Ask who actually saw them together.
say.tip: 亲眼 qīnyǎn = with your own eyes. 到底 dàodǐ = actually, in the end: pressing for the truth.

ok.zh: 我楼下的楼下的邻居看见的。
ok.en: The neighbour of the neighbour below me saw them.

answers: 空口无凭，到底谁亲眼看见了？
空口无凭，谁亲眼看见了？
4.gloss: Words are cheap. Who actually saw it with their own eyes?
4.tip: 空口无凭 = an empty mouth is no proof: say-so isn't evidence.

steps.zh: 公园里，一个音箱，两个人在跳舞。
steps.en: The park. A speaker. Two people, dancing.

steps.narr: You remember the poster in the lift: the estate talent show, Saturday.

steps.en: You know something, don't you, dear?

say.en: Keep their secret, or tell the group they're practising.
say.tip: 什么也没…… = didn't ... anything at all: 什么也没看见.

ok.en: Our young neighbour is no fun at all!

answers: 他们在练舞，为了才艺比赛！
alts.gloss: They're practising, for the talent show!

then.en: When I was young, I danced too...

answers: 我什么也没看见，大家也别说了。
我什么都没看见，大家就别说了。
4.gloss: I didn't see a thing, and nobody needs to say any more.

answers: 人家在练舞，准备才艺比赛呢！
alts.gloss: They're practising, getting ready for the talent show!

steps.en: 老周 sends a thumbs-up, and a dance video. Forty minutes long. 💃

else.en: By ten, half the group wants to join the dance. 老周 asked you first. 💃
